purpose: 31 strongest prior Weiser source-screen facts are separately copy-edited to declarative standalone bilingual Home statements. Original draft observations retained as research evidence, not overwritten. FEATURE / RESERVE / HOLD are research rankings not human approvals.
render_contract: Home already displays DID YOU KNOW THAT… / LE SAVIEZ-VOUS ?; statement below must be declarative without repeating heading

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: In Ukrainian Christmas Eve traditions, a grain sheaf called a didukh was brought into the home.
display_statement.fr: Dans les traditions ukrainiennes de la veille de Noël, une gerbe de céréales appelée didukh était introduite dans la maison.

records.scope_and_review_note: Eastern Christian and regional context, not a universal Latin practice

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: Early German Advent calendars could reveal a new picture behind a small window each day.
display_statement.fr: Les anciens calendriers de l'Avent allemands pouvaient dévoiler chaque jour une nouvelle image derrière une petite fenêtre.

records.scope_and_review_note: Historically documented, but well-known rather than surprising

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: In parts of the Alps, a picture of the Virgin Mary passed from home to home over nine evenings before Christmas.
display_statement.fr: Dans certaines régions alpines, une image de la Vierge Marie passait de maison en maison pendant neuf soirées avant Noël.

records.scope_and_review_note: Regional historical devotion; do not restore unverified Adnet attribution

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: The Advent play Herbergsuchen dramatized Mary and Joseph's search for lodging before Christ's birth.
display_statement.fr: La représentation de l'Avent appelée Herbergsuchen mettait en scène la recherche d'un logement par Marie et Joseph avant la naissance du Christ.

records.scope_and_review_note: German historical religious drama, not a universal household rite

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: Some central European families built Nativity scenes with hundreds of figures, large enough to fill a room.
display_statement.fr: Certaines familles d'Europe centrale construisaient des crèches de centaines de personnages, assez vastes pour remplir une pièce.

records.scope_and_review_note: Historical mountain-region examples; not typical of all European families

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: The northern Slavic szopka was a puppet theatre that alternated Nativity episodes with other dramatic scenes.
display_statement.fr: La szopka des pays slaves du Nord était un théâtre de marionnettes alternant épisodes de la Nativité et autres scènes.

records.scope_and_review_note: Do not confuse with house-to-house Hungarian Nativity plays

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: Before Christmas, boys in some Alpine districts carried an image of Saint Joseph to different homes on successive nights.
display_statement.fr: Avant Noël, des garçons de certaines régions alpines portaient une image de saint Joseph dans différentes maisons plusieurs soirs de suite.

records.scope_and_review_note: The source identifies a statue; independent confirmation absent; similar to Marian house visits

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: Lenten pretzels were sometimes given as alms to poor people in central Europe.
display_statement.fr: En Europe centrale, des bretzels de Carême étaient parfois distribués en aumône aux personnes démunies.

records.scope_and_review_note: Historical food charity, not a prescribed fasting rule

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: In older Spanish celebrations, balconies were decorated with flowers and candles on the eve of the Immaculate Conception.
display_statement.fr: Lors d'anciennes célébrations espagnoles, des balcons étaient ornés de fleurs et de cierges la veille de l'Immaculée Conception.

records.scope_and_review_note: Regional description; local attribution needs source review before date targeting

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: Weiser recorded the French réveillon as a Christmas family meal following Midnight Mass.
display_statement.fr: Weiser présentait le réveillon français comme un repas familial de Noël pris après la messe de minuit.

records.scope_and_review_note: No unsupported comparison with a pre-Mass Gros Souper

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: Some German and Austrian Easter celebrations included an Osterritt, a religious procession on horseback.
display_statement.fr: Certaines fêtes pascales allemandes et autrichiennes comprenaient un Osterritt, procession religieuse à cheval.

records.scope_and_review_note: Historical regional custom, not a universal Easter procession

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: In some European Corpus Christi processions, children dressed as angels scattered flower petals.
display_statement.fr: Dans certaines processions européennes de la Fête-Dieu, des enfants habillés en anges répandaient des pétales de fleurs.

records.scope_and_review_note: Do not infer every institute or 1962 celebration requires it

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: An old German-Austrian custom called Kindelwiegen involved rocking a cradle holding a figure of the Christ Child while singing carols.
display_statement.fr: Une ancienne coutume germano-autrichienne, le Kindelwiegen, consistait à bercer une crèche avec une figure de l'Enfant Jésus au chant des noëls.

records.scope_and_review_note: Historical custom, not a prescribed ritual action

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: English Mothering Sunday visits once brought families to their mother church, sometimes with a simnel cake.
display_statement.fr: En Angleterre, le Mothering Sunday ramenait autrefois les familles à leur église-mère, parfois avec un simnel cake.

records.scope_and_review_note: Historical English Christian custom, not uniquely Catholic or prescribed in the Missal

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: Saint Lucy's December celebrations in Scandinavia came to feature candlelit processions and festive breakfasts.
display_statement.fr: En Scandinavie, les fêtes de sainte Lucie en décembre ont pris la forme de processions aux chandelles et de petits déjeuners festifs.

records.scope_and_review_note: Regional custom crossing confessional boundaries; avoid making it an official Roman procession

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: In nineteenth-century Boston, children were encouraged to leave Christmas gifts for poor families beside a parish Nativity crib.
display_statement.fr: À Boston, au XIXe siècle, des enfants étaient invités à déposer auprès de la crèche paroissiale des cadeaux de Noël destinés aux familles pauvres.

records.scope_and_review_note: Local historical charity account, not proof of widespread current practice

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: The old Easter greeting Surrexit Dominus vere means 'The Lord has truly risen'.
display_statement.fr: L'ancienne salutation pascale Surrexit Dominus vere signifie « Le Seigneur est vraiment ressuscité ».

records.scope_and_review_note: Accurate short Latin translation; common liturgical formula rather than standout discovery

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: In some central and eastern European communities, families decorated candles before bringing them for the Candlemas blessing.
display_statement.fr: Dans certaines communautés d'Europe centrale et orientale, les familles décoraient les cierges avant de les porter à la bénédiction de la Chandeleur.

records.scope_and_review_note: Candle decoration distinguished from the authorised blessing

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: Polish All Souls customs sometimes included leaving an empty place at table and sharing food with the poor.
display_statement.fr: En Pologne, certaines coutumes de la Commémoration des défunts prévoyaient une place vide à table et le partage de nourriture avec les pauvres.

records.scope_and_review_note: Household symbolism not doctrine that the deceased physically occupy a place

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: Weiser linked Hungarian harvest thanksgiving to the Assumption, and separately described Polish harvest-wreath processions.
display_statement.fr: Weiser associait en Hongrie l'action de grâce des moissons à l'Assomption et décrivait séparément des processions polonaises de couronnes de récolte.

records.scope_and_review_note: Do not imply the same fixed feast date in both countries

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: Weiser reported regional seed blessings associated with the Nativity of the Virgin Mary on 8 September.
display_statement.fr: Weiser rapportait des bénédictions régionales de semences associées à la Nativité de la Vierge Marie, le 8 septembre.

records.scope_and_review_note: Need distinct source text for priestly blessing, ritual book, geography and historical date before Home use

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: The old Ember Days joined seasonal prayer and penance with thanksgiving for the harvest.
display_statement.fr: Les anciens Quatre-Temps associaient prière saisonnière et pénitence à l'action de grâce pour les récoltes.

records.scope_and_review_note: Historical connection, not a statement of today's binding fasting law

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: Some historical Ascension festivities included pastries baked in the shape of birds.
display_statement.fr: Certaines anciennes fêtes de l'Ascension comprenaient des pâtisseries façonnées en forme d'oiseaux.

records.scope_and_review_note: Specific regional baker practice, not a liturgical food blessing

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: On the feast of the Annunciation, historical Roman charities provided marriage dowries for poor girls.
display_statement.fr: À Rome, des œuvres charitables historiques offraient des dots à des jeunes filles pauvres pour la fête de l'Annonciation.

records.scope_and_review_note: Institutional historical practice; do not claim a universal obligation

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: Some central European households marked eight evenings of prayer for the dead after All Souls.
display_statement.fr: Dans certains foyers d'Europe centrale, huit soirées de prière pour les défunts suivaient la Commémoration des fidèles défunts.

records.scope_and_review_note: Household prayer cycle must not be mistaken for an official liturgical octave

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: In parts of Austria, children received special breads in exchange for prayers for the departed.
display_statement.fr: Dans certaines régions d'Autriche, les enfants recevaient des pains particuliers en échange de prières pour les défunts.

records.scope_and_review_note: Regional household exchange; not an indulgence guarantee

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: Some Christmas trees carried edible pastry decorations that were later shared with children.
display_statement.fr: Certains sapins de Noël portaient des décorations en pâtisserie que l'on partageait ensuite avec les enfants.

records.scope_and_review_note: Low liturgical specificity, suitable as cultural context

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: Some medieval communities staged a ceremonial farewell to the Alleluia before Lent.
display_statement.fr: Certaines communautés médiévales célébraient un adieu cérémoniel à l'Alléluia avant le Carême.

records.scope_and_review_note: Historical ceremony; cannot imply a required 1962 rubrical action

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: Weiser described roses falling through the roof opening of Rome's Pantheon on the Sunday after Ascension.
display_statement.fr: Weiser décrivait des roses tombant par l'ouverture de la coupole du Panthéon de Rome le dimanche suivant l'Ascension.

records.scope_and_review_note: Historically reported Sunday after Ascension, not automatically today's Pentecost practice

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: In some medieval churches, a dove figure descended through an opening in the roof during Pentecost celebrations.
display_statement.fr: Dans certaines églises médiévales, une figure de colombe descendait par une ouverture dans le toit lors des fêtes de la Pentecôte.

records.scope_and_review_note: Medieval symbolism; not a currently authorised Mass instruction

records.source_edition: Handbook of Christian Feasts and Customs (1958)

display_statement.en: Some Christmas cribs received their figure of the Christ Child only after the Christmas Mass.
display_statement.fr: Dans certaines crèches de Noël, on ne plaçait la figurine de l'Enfant Jésus qu'après la messe de Noël.

records.scope_and_review_note: Timing differs locally; avoid absolute liturgical claim
